comments.content: The devcontainer base image is referenced by a mutable tag rather than an immutable digest, so CI or developer environments can change when the upstream tag is rebuilt. Pin the image to a digest, or use a project-controlled Dockerfile, to make the container reproducible.
comments.thinking: ci-reproducibility: mutable container tags can shift toolchains and OS packages without a repository change.

comments.content: The post-create step installs the latest available `just` each time, which makes the development container non-reproducible and can introduce unexpected breakage. Pin the installed crate version.
comments.thinking: ci-reproducibility: unversioned cargo install resolves to whatever version is latest at container creation time.
